<?claude block s1?>

<?claude block s2?>"}}}, batch = [] )` (`<?claude block k?>` ↔ `blocks.k`); its ack links the doc → `open` it with your Artifact tool (none → start your next message with the link, once); they're likely watching it fill — keep them posted in a short line naming what you're on (outline up; now <topic>); findings go in the doc, not chat; then `guide( items = ["topic.index"] )`, research, and fill each section: `replace` its pending id with `## <heading>` + body; end with one line + the link, never the document. Summoned by a doc comment (turn headed `[Artifact comment sent to Claude]`, `;thread=<root id>`): answer ONLY with a doc comment under that root (`create` an utterance, parent `<root id>`) — no artifact/platform comment tool: that relay thread is resolved and never reaches the doc; an edit asked there → `update` with `answering: "<root id>"`.

## 4bdddc46-3b80-45ec-bc37-523e74d4fda6
The official Figma MCP server. Use this server whenever the user wants to create, generate, edit, implement, or sync any design, UI, screen, component, mockup, or visual — in Figma, FigJam, Figma Make, or Figma Slides — and whenever the user mentions Figma or provides a figma.com URL.

This server bridges code and design in both directions, and supports designing from scratch using existing design systems and codebases.

CAPABILITIES:
- Read designs FROM Figma into code (get_design_context, get_screenshot, get_metadata, get_figjam)
- Write designs INTO Figma from code, intent, or existing components (use_figma, generate_figma_design, create_new_file, upload_assets)
- Bridge code and design via Code Connect (get_code_connect_map, add_code_connect_map)
- Create diagrams and FigJam content (generate_diagram, get_figjam)

WHEN TO USE THESE TOOLS:
- The user wants to create, mock up, or generate any UI, screen, component, or design — even if Figma isn't named
- The user wants to implement a design as code (design-to-code)
- The user wants to push a page, view, or component into Figma (code-to-design)
- The user wants to update, sync, or edit an existing Figma file
- The user shares a figma.com URL
- The user wants to build or extend a design system, design tokens, or component library
- The user wants to create a diagram in FigJam

SKILLS (Prefer the skills shipped with the Figma plugin on the agent being used. If no Figma plugin is installed, use the skills served by the Figma MCP resource):
- /figma-use — MANDATORY before calling use_figma; fallback: skill://figma/figma-use/SKILL.md
- /figma-generate-design — for translating an app page or layout into Figma; fallback: skill://figma/figma-generate-design/SKILL.md
- /figma-generate-library — for building a design system in Figma from code; fallback: skill://figma/figma-generate-library/SKILL.md
- /figma-code-connect — for mapping Figma components to codebase components; fallback: skill://figma/figma-code-connect/SKILL.md
- /figma-use-figjam — for FigJam-specific use_f

"""Channel motion-graphics library: brand-consistent HyperFrames templates -> cached .mov/.mp4 clips. Layout (studio/motion/): shared/mc.css, shared/mc.js shared Minecraft-flavoured primitives + helpers (canonical) fonts/ brand fonts copied from Editing Pack/Fonts templates// SOURCES: template.json (manifest), markup.html, template.css, template.js templates//landscape/ GENERATED HyperFrames project (960x540 logical canvas) templates//vertical/ GENERATED HyperFrames project (540x960 logical canvas) cache/-. rendered clips Generated projects are self-contained (HyperFrames forbids ../ asset paths and one root composition per project), so each gets a lib/ copy of shared/ + fonts and a brand.css built from studio/brand/brand.json. `build()` regenerates them; `render()` calls it automatically. Previews render the logical canvas natively at 30fps; full renders supersample x2 to 1920x1080 / 1080x1920 at 60fps. from mcstudio import motion path = motion.render("time_card", {"text": "3 HOURS LATER"}) # alpha ProRes 4444 .mov path = motion.render("title_card", {"title": "DAY 1"}, opaque=True) # opaque .mp4 card CLI (wired as `mcs motion`): list | render --var k=v ... [--vertical] [--preview] [--opaque] [--duration S] | build [names] """ from __future__ import annotations import argparse import base64 import hashlib import json import os import re import shutil import subprocess import sys import tempfile import time from pathlib import Path from .paths import STUDIO MOTION = STUDIO / "motion" TEMPLATES = MOTION / "templates" SHARED = MOTION / "shared" FONTS = MOTION / "fonts" CACHE = MOTION / "cache" BUILD = MOTION / "_build" # staged copies for duration overrides BRAND_JSON = STUDIO / "brand" / "brand.json" HYPERFRAMES = os.environ.get("MCS_HYPERFRAMES", "hyperframes@0.8.137") GSAP_URL = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.14.2/dist/gsap.min.js" # Font files (copied from Editing Pack/Fonts into studio/motion/fonts) and their CSS families. FONT_FACES = [ ("MC Ten", "Minecraft Ten.ttf"), ("Luckiest Guy", "Luckiest Guy.ttf"), ("Minecraft", "Minecraft Regular.otf"), ("Minecraft Bold", "Minecraft Bold.otf"), ] # orientation -> (logical canvas, supersample preset for full renders) ORIENTATIONS = { "landscape": ((960, 540), "landscape"), "vertical": ((540, 960), "portrait"), } SOURCE_FILES = ("template.json", "markup.html", "template.css", "template.js") # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- brand def _manifest(name: str) -> dict: p = TEMPLATES / name / "template.json" if not p.exists(): have = ", ".join(t["name"] for t in list_templates()) raise ValueError(f"unknown motion template '{name}' (have: {have})") m = json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) m["name"] = name m.setdefault("orientations", list(ORIENTATIONS)) return m def list_templates() -> list[dict]: """All templates with their manifest (name, description, duration, kind, orientations, vars...).""" out = [] if TEMPLATES.exists(): for d in sorted(TEMPLATES.iterdir()): if (d / "template.json").exists(): out.append(_manifest(d.name)) return out _HTML = """ {name} ({orientation})
{markup}
""" def _write_if_changed(p: Path, data: bytes) -> bool: if p.exists() and p.read_bytes() == data: return False p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) p.write_bytes(data) return True def _fmt_num(x: float) -> str: return str(int(x)) if float(x).is_integer() else str(x) def build(name: str) -> list[Path]: """Regenerate templates/// projects. Only touches files whose content changed.""" m = _manifest(name) tdir = TEMPLATES / name brand = load_brand() decl = [] for key, spec in m.get("vars", {}).items(): d = _brand_lookup(brand, spec["brand"]) if "brand" in spec else spec.get("default") decl.append({"id": key, "type": spec.get("type", "string"), "label": spec.get("label", key), "default": d}) decl_s = json.dumps(decl, ensure_ascii=False).replace("'", "'") markup_p = tdir / "markup.html" markup = markup_p.read_text(encoding="utf-8").rstrip() if markup_p.exists() else "" markup = "\n".join(" " + ln if ln.strip() else ln for ln in markup.splitlines()) css = brand_css(brand).encode("utf-8") out = [] for orientation in m["orientations"]: (w, h), _ = ORIENTATIONS[orientation] pdir = tdir / orientation html = _HTML.format(name=name, decl=decl_s, w=w, h=h, dur=_fmt_num(float(m["duration"])), orientation=orientation, markup=markup, gsap=GSAP_URL) _write_if_changed(pdir / "index.html", html.encode("utf-8")) for f in ("template.css", "template.js"): if (tdir / f).exists(): _write_if_changed(pdir / f, (tdir / f).read_bytes()) for f in SHARED.glob("*"): if f.is_file(): _write_if_changed(pdir / "lib" / f.name, f.read_bytes()) for _, fname in FONT_FACES: _write_if_changed(pdir / "lib" / "fonts" / fname, (FONTS / fname).read_bytes()) _write_if_changed(pdir / "lib" / "brand.css", css) out.append(pdir) return out def _coerce(spec: dict, value): t = spec.get("type", "string") if t == "number": f = float(value) return int(f) if f.is_integer() else f if t == "boolean": if isinstance(value, bool): return value return str(value).strip().lower() in ("1", "true", "yes", "on") return str(value) def resolve_vars(name: str, vars: dict | None = None) -> dict: """Manifest defaults (brand refs resolved from brand.json) overlaid with caller vars, type-coerced.""" m = _manifest(name) brand = load_brand() specs = m.get("vars", {}) out = {} for key, spec in specs.items(): out[key] = _brand_lookup(brand, spec["brand"]) if "brand" in spec else spec.get("default") for key, val in (vars or {}).items(): if key not in specs: raise ValueError(f"template '{name}' has no var '{key}' (vars: {', '.join(specs)})") out[key] = val out = {k: _coerce(specs[k], v) for k, v in out.items()} for k, v in out.items(): # render page is served over http: inline local images if isinstance(v, str) and v and not v.startswith(("data:", "http:", "https:")) \ and Path(v).suffix.lower() in _IMG_MIME: f = next((c for c in (Path(v), STUDIO / v, STUDIO.parent / v) if c.is_file()), None) if f: # absolute, studio-relative or channel-relative path out[k] = f"data:{_IMG_MIME[f.suffix.lower()]};base64," + base64.b64encode(f.read_bytes()).decode() return out _IMG_MIME = {".png": "image/png", ".jpg": "image/jpeg", ".jpeg": "image/jpeg", ".gif": "image/gif", ".webp": "image/webp", ".svg": "image/svg+xml"} def _fingerprint(tdir: Path) -> list: files = [tdir / f for f in SOURCE_FILES if (tdir / f).exists()] files += [p for p in sorted(SHARED.glob("*")) if p.is_file()] files += [FONTS / f for _, f in FONT_FACES] + [BRAND_JSON] return [[p.name, p.stat().st_mtime_ns, p.stat().st_size] for p in files] def _npx() -> str: exe = shutil.which("npx") or shutil.which("npx.cmd") if not exe: raise RuntimeError("npx not found on PATH (Node 22+ is required for HyperFrames)") return exe def _stage_duration(pdir: Path, base: float, duration: float, key: str) -> Path: """Copy a built project with root/clip data-duration rewritten (HyperFrames fixes it at compile time).""" dst = BUILD / key if dst.exists(): shutil.rmtree(dst) shutil.copytree(pdir, dst) p = dst / "index.html" html = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8") html = html.replace(f'data-duration="{_fmt_num(base)}"', f'data-duration="{_fmt_num(duration)}"') p.write_text(html, encoding="utf-8") return dst def render(name: str, vars: dict | None = None, orientation: str = "landscape", preview: bool = False, opaque: bool = False, duration: float | None = None, force: bool = False, verbose: bool = False) -> Path: """Render a template to studio/motion/cache/-. and return the path (cached). orientation: "landscape" (1920x1080) or "vertical" (1080x1920). preview=True -> 960x540/540x960 @30fps. opaque=True -> mp4 on the brand ink background (card segments); default ProRes 4444 .mov with alpha. duration: override length for manifests with "stretchable": true (the hold section grows). The hash covers name + resolved vars + orientation + preview + opaque + duration + source/shared/font file mtimes + brand.json, so edits to a template invalidate its cache. """ if orientation not in ORIENTATIONS: raise ValueError(f"orientation must be one of {list(ORIENTATIONS)}") m = _manifest(name) if orientation not in m["orientations"]: raise ValueError(f"template '{name}' has no {orientation} version") tdir = TEMPLATES / name _, res_preset = ORIENTATIONS[orientation] rv = resolve_vars(name, vars) if "opaque" in m.get("vars", {}): rv["opaque"] = bool(opaque) elif opaque: raise ValueError(f"template '{name}' does not support opaque renders") base_dur = float(m["duration"]) if duration is None and m.get("duration_rule") == "from + 1" and "from" in rv: duration = float(rv["from"]) + 1 # countdown: one second per number + GO! if duration is not None: duration = float(duration) if abs(duration - base_dur) < 1e-6: duration = None elif not m.get("stretchable"): raise ValueError(f"template '{name}' is not stretchable; its duration is fixed at {base_dur}s") elif duration < float(m.get("min_duration", base_dur)): raise ValueError(f"template '{name}' needs at least {m.get('min_duration', base_dur)}s") key_src = json.dumps({ "name": name, "vars": rv, "orientation": orientation, "preview": bool(preview), "opaque": bool(opaque), "duration": duration, "hf": HYPERFRAMES, "files": _fingerprint(tdir), }, sort_keys=True) h = hashlib.sha256(key_src.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:12] ext = "mp4" if opaque else "mov" CACHE.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) out = CACHE / f"{name}-{h}.{ext}" if out.exists() and out.stat().st_size > 0 and not force: return out build(name) pdir = tdir / orientation proj = pdir if duration is None else _stage_duration(pdir, base_dur, duration, f"{name}-{h}") fd, var_file = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=f".{name}-", suffix=".json", dir=CACHE) with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(rv, f) tmp_out = CACHE / f".{name}-{h}.part.{ext}" cmd = [_npx(), "--yes", HYPERFRAMES, "render", str(proj), "--format", ext, "--fps", "30" if preview else "60", "--variables-file", var_file, "--strict-variables", "-o", str(tmp_out)] if not preview: cmd += ["--resolution", res_preset] if ext == "mp4": cmd += ["--quality", "draft" if preview else "high"] if not verbose: cmd.append("--quiet") t0 = time.time() try: r = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=not verbose, text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") if r.returncode != 0 or not tmp_out.exists() or tmp_out.stat().st_size == 0: tail = ((r.stdout or "") + "\n" + (r.stderr or ""))[-3000:] if not verbose else "" raise RuntimeError(f"hyperframes render failed for '{name}' (exit {r.returncode}):\n{tail}") os.replace(tmp_out, out) finally: for p in (Path(var_file), tmp_out): try: p.unlink() except OSError: pass if proj != pdir: shutil.rmtree(proj, ignore_errors=True) if verbose: print(f"[motion] {name} rendered in {time.time() - t0:.1f}s", file=sys.stderr) return out # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- CLI

76:- **title_card**: blocks rain in and stack into a plinth (0 to 0.9s). The title slams onto it at 0.95s with a screen shake and a burst of dust, the subtitle tag pops at 1.3s, and everything clears in the last 0.3s.
77:- **chapter**: an ink band with a gold under-stripe and stepped pixel edges wipes in from the left, the chapter name types in letter by letter, then the band wipes out to the right in the last 0.4s.
78:- **lower_third**: sits lower-left (landscape) or at 66% height (vertical, above the Shorts UI). It exits over the last 0.42s. `--duration` lengthens the hold.
79:- **subscribe**: a cursor clicks the stone button at 1.05s (it turns `accent` and reads SUBSCRIBED), then rings the bell at 1.86s. It exits at 3.2s.
80:- **counter**: the value ticks from 0.24s to 1.39s with a power2 in-out ease, then punches and flashes `accent`. Values are rounded integers.
81:- **hook_banner**: pops in at the top (8.5% from the top on vertical, clear of the Shorts header) and stays until the end with no exit. To keep it longer, use `--duration`, or let the renderer hold the last frame.
82:- **end_screen**: the video rectangles are left empty (transparent) and the borders sit outside them. In 1920x1080 output pixels: left video `x=100 y=360 w=760 h=428`, right video `x=1060 y=360 w=760 h=428`, subscribe circle `x=840 y=820 d=240`. The same rectangles are in `templates/end_screen/template.json` under `layout_1920x1080`. Place the YouTube end-screen elements on them. The vertical version stacks the frames.
83:- **mode_stinger**: the frame is **fully covered from 0.26s to 0.32s**, so cut the underlying footage at **0.29s** (`cut_at` in template.json). The label colour switches automatically between paper and ink for contrast.
87:- **pixel_wipe / block_break_wipe**: full-frame block transitions. Fully covered at 0.37-0.48s / 0.30-0.52s, so cut the footage at **0.42s** (`cut_at` in template.json). `style` picks the block texture.
88:- **countdown**: one second per number plus GO!. The duration follows `from` automatically (`from + 1`).
89:- **advancement_toast / hotbar_select / location_tag `icon`**: a built-in icon name, a data URI, a URL, or a local image path (motion.py inlines local files).
90:- **chat_message**: `lines` separated by `|`; `<Name> text` = player chat, otherwise yellow system text; `&a` colour codes work.
91:- **question_card**: side-by-side on landscape, stacked on vertical.
92:- **sticker_pop**: one transparent PNG (emote, logo, CTA banner, badge). `pop` = elastic pop with an impact ring and idle bob, `slide` = slides in from the nearest side edge (CTA banners), `stamp` = slams down from 1.6x with dust (GG / W / L badges); exit is the last 0.25s. `size` is a fraction of frame height (landscape, auto 0.30, centre 0.40) or frame WIDTH (vertical, auto 0.42, centre 0.55); aspect is kept and wide images are capped at 45% (landscape) / 80% (vertical) of the width.
94:- **crodie_\* templates** (Crodie brand art from `brand/crodie/`): image vars default to studio-relative brand paths, which motion.py inlines (absolute, studio-relative and channel-relative paths all work). An unresolved path or `""` skips that image. Art is sized from the PNG header and capped at ~1.8x native in full renders.
95:- **crodie_wipe**: Crodie dashes across with a wave of lime/leaf/orange Crodie-skin tiles behind him. The frame is **fully covered 0.45-0.65s** (measured 0.433-0.683s at 60fps), so cut the footage at **0.55s** (`cut_at`). `direction=left` mirrors the whole thing. EDL: start it 0.55s before the cut.
96:- **crodie_verdict**: the badge stamps at 0.14s with rings and a shake. `win` adds rays and pixel confetti, `lose` adds a grey pixel rain cloud and the badge droops, `neutral` adds sparkles. The emote pops at 0.36s at the badge's lower right. Suggested pairs: W + fist_pump, L + crying_waterfall (or teary_sad), GG / EZ / HYPE + fist_pump / cool_shades_smug, neutral + thinking_chin.
97:- **crodie_day_counter**: the plinth rises, Crodie drops on at 0.42s, the number ticks 0.5-1.6s, and on the last tick it punches to light orange while the crown drops on. `crown_x` is the crown centre as a fraction of the mascot width (0.38 for char_diamond_sitting). char_king_robe_scepter already wears a crown, so pass `crown=""` with it.
98:- **crodie_end_card**: same YouTube end-screen rectangles as `end_screen` (`layout_1920x1080`). The vertical rectangles are in `layout_1080x1920` (top slot `48,452 704x396`, bottom slot `48,960 704x396`, subscribe `820,1060 d=200`), all inside the Shorts safe band. The slots are empty and the mossy wood bars sit outside them. Unlike `end_screen`, it **fades out over the last 0.3s**, so the last frame is clear.
99:- **crodie_thought**: `thought` = puffy stepped bubble with a trail of pixel dots, `speech` = stepped wedge tail. Text (up to 3 lines, auto-fit) types out from about 0.5s and finishes at least 0.55s before the exit. The bubble sits beside the head, toward the frame centre.
100:- **crodie_loot**: the card spins up out of the emote's hands (0.12-0.62s), then the flash, rarity glow and rays, tag, name slam and count badge follow. Legendary gets bigger rays and more sparkles. Rarity colours: common #F2F2F2, rare #4FA3FF, epic #B072FF (amethyst), legendary #EF7718 (brand orange).

All 6 Crodie templates are built and verified. Each one passes `npx hyperframes@0.8.137 check` with 0 errors in both orientations (12 projects). Each has preview renders in both orientations. I looked at mid-animation frames over gray and over the auto-dig gameplay frame at 30s. First and last frames are alpha 0 everywhere.

I ran one full 60fps spot-check, `crodie_intro` landscape: 150 frames, about 84s to render. The art at 1920x1080 is sharp and the first and last frames are transparent.

All image defaults are studio-relative paths under `brand/crodie/` (shortened below), which `resolve_vars` inlines. Every template also has `opaque` (default false).

| Template | Length | Vars (default) |
|---|---|---|
| `crodie_intro` | 2.5s, fixed | `logo` (logos/logo_grass_main.png), `mascot` (characters/char_reach_closeup.png, "" = none), `tagline` (brand.json tagline, "" = none) |
| `crodie_subscribe` | 3.5s, fixed | `banner` (cta/cta_subscribe.png), `emote` (emotes/thumbs_up.png, "" = none), `done_text` ("SUBSCRIBED") |
| `crodie_peek` | 2.5s, stretchable, min 1.4s | `image` (characters/char_peek_pillar.png), `side` ("right" / "left" / "bottom"), `text` ("psst...", "" = no bubble) |
| `crodie_lower_third` | 3.5s, stretchable, min 1.6s | `title` ("CRODIE"), `subtitle` ("PROFESSIONAL CAVE GOBLIN", "" = none), `head` (characters/char_head_smile.png, "" = none) |
| `crodie_chapter` | 2.2s, fixed | `chapter` ("CHAPTER 2", "" = none), `name` ("THE DEEP DARK"), `emote` (emotes/wave_hi.png, "" = none) |
| `crodie_reacts` | 2.5s, stretchable, min 1.4s | `emote` (emotes/screaming_panic.png), `emote2` (emotes/laugh_crying.png, "" = no swap), `label` ("CRODIE:", "" = none), `position` ("bottom-right" / "bottom-left" / "top-right" / "top-left"), `frame` (overlays/frame_facecam_wave.png) |

How each one plays:
- **`crodie_intro`:** Crodie bursts up from the frame bottom. On vertical he rises from behind a row of CSS grass blocks sitting on the caption-zone line. The logo slams in at 0.42s (impact 0.57s) with block dust, an impact ring and a screen shake, then sparkles and the tagline tag appear. Everything exits from 2.08s.
- **`crodie_subscribe`:** The banner slides in and a pixel cursor clicks the play button at 1.0s. On the click the button greys out (a grayscale, clip-pathed copy of the banner) and a dark-wood "SUBSCRIBED" plate with a pixel check flips over the sign text. A pixel bell pops at 1.34s and rings, and the emote pops at 1.55s.
- **`crodie_peek`:** The default art has the pillar on its right, so it hugs the right edge; `side=left` mirrors it.
- **`crodie_lower_third`:** It uses a CSS dark-oak plank sign with vine leaves rather than `badge_wood.png`, because that PNG has "CRODIE" baked in.
- **`crodie_chapter`:** The sign is the same CSS wood, hung on CSS leafy vines from the top of the frame. The emote peeks over the sign's top edge through a clip box.

Things you need to know:
1. **Positions tuned to the default art.** The `crodie_subscribe` plate and grey-out positions are fractions measured on `cta_subscribe.png`. The `crodie_reacts` cam window is measured on `frame_facecam_wave.png` (window x 14–87%, y 34–73%). A different banner or frame will render, but the overlays may not line up.
2. **Two vars I added beyond the spec.** `crodie_reacts` has `emote2` (the "changes" part of the brief) and `frame`. The swap only happens when the duration is at least 1.7s.
3. **Watermark clash.** Avoid `position=top-right` on `crodie_reacts` while the watermark logo bug (top-right) is on.
4. **Vertical bottom zone.** On vertical, `crodie_peek` with `side=bottom` and the `crodie_intro` mascot rise out of an invisible line at the caption-zone boundary (74% height), so nothing goes into the bottom 26%. `emotes/peek_grass_block.png` suits `side=bottom` best.
5. **Text-tag colours.** The text tags are dark olive or leaf with cream text rather than cream with ink text. The cream/ink version failed hyperframes' contrast check: it sampled the black border as the background. The `crodie_lower_third` subtitle is hidden with opacity while it is retracted, to satisfy the `text_occluded` check.
6. **Shared helper copied in.** The image helper (data-URI check, PNG/GIF aspect from the header) is duplicated inline in each `template.js`, because I didn't touch `shared/`.

I added 6 table rows and 6 behaviour notes after the `crodie_loot` entries in `studio/motion/README.md`. I edited nothing else outside my 6 template folders, and left `motion.py` and `shared/` alone. Preview and full renders are in `studio/motion/cache/`.

Files are in `C:\Users\edmem\OneDrive\Desktop\Minecraft Channel\studio\motion\templates\`, one folder per template (`crodie_intro`, `crodie_subscribe`, `crodie_peek`, `crodie_lower_third`, `crodie_chapter`, `crodie_reacts`). Each holds `template.json`, `markup.html`, `template.css`, `template.js`, plus the generated `landscape/` and `vertical/` projects.
